programs.title: Kangaroo Beach
programs.desc: The cadets build the Grand Crabby Hotel to protect rock pool sea creatures from the seagulls, but soon learn that despite being tough they shouldn't be moved.

programs.title: The Octonauts
programs.sub_title: The Octonauts and the Crab and Urchin
programs.desc: Barnacles and Kwazii investigate a disruption on a nearby reef: a Carrier Crab and the Urchin who lives on its shell just can't seem to get along.

programs.title: Thomas & Friends: All Engines Go!
programs.desc: When the power goes out all over Sodor, Thomas and Friends must use brainpower to navigate the island in creative new ways.

programs.title: Play School: Down At The Beach
programs.desc: Leah and Takaya get ready to have fun down at the beach! There's so much to discover! They make a craft rock pool and are later joined by Bucky the Seagull!

programs.title: Fireman Sam
programs.desc: The Pontypandy Pioneers must make a cup of tea to earn a badge and a new Pioneer Vest, but Peter and Mandy manage to accidentally start a forest fire!

programs.title: Miffy and Friends
programs.desc: Poor Melanie has broken her arm by playing football and must get an arm cast. Miffy starts to be a bit envious of Melanie. Having an arm cast seems so cool!

programs.title: The Woohoos!
programs.desc: The Woohoos find what they think is a fallen star on the beach and attempt to help it get back to the sky. They learn that there are sea creatures shaped like stars.

programs.title: Nikhil & Jay
programs.sub_title: Nikhil and Jay and the Birthday Huff
programs.desc: It's Max the cat's birthday but Nikhil and Jay are in a huff with each other. Amma and Appa try to get them to say sorry to each other, but it is just too hard.

programs.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
programs.desc: At the playground, Daniel wants to swing as high as Jodi. Nana teaches Daniel that he's big enough now to try it himself!

programs.title: Mittens & Pants
programs.desc: Post Pig Petunia's mail van has broken down. Mittens tries to help her fix it, but it's no use. Now how will the mail get delivered? By hitching a ride on another vehicle, but which one?

programs.title: BeddyByes
programs.desc: MeMo and BaBa explore all types of connections: daisy chains, little cars, holding hands. They discover that there are many ways to connect on the wonderful Planet BeddyByes.

programs.title: Mixmups
programs.desc: When the Mixmups spy a rainbow in the Sky, they go on an adventure to find out what lies at the end of it.
